metadata.title: Salesforce sparks a software-stock rally — and pushes back on AI doomsday fears - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Salesforce sparks a software-stock rally — and pushes back on AI doomsday fears
Salesforce’s earnings showed that AI isn’t killing traditional software, and that the operators of major AI models are willing to strike partnerships with legacy vendors
Salesforce’s earnings just sent a confident signal to investors that artificial intelligence isn’t a “death knell” for the software sector, in the words of one analyst.
Software stocks are broadly rallying in Thursday’s premarket trading as the commentary from Salesforce — as well as from companies like Okta OKTA and CrowdStrike Holdings CRWD — resonated with the investment community.
